dict.string: Open Names to see installed apps. Type a replacement name in the field beside the app. The name is applied to its Home Screen icon. Clear the field to restore the app's original name.

Open Image Changing and tap the app you want to customize. Choose a picture from your photo library and confirm it. The picture is scaled to fit inside the square app icon with a small margin, so the whole photo remains visible. Changes are cosmetic and do not modify the original app bundle.

The Home Screen is notified when a name or picture changes. If an icon does not refresh immediately, respring SpringBoard. Use the Reset button beneath an app in either category to restore that app's original name and picture together. The Home Screen refreshes automatically; respring if an icon does not update immediately.
Designed for jailbroken classic iOS devices, including iOS 6. Some system icons may be rendered differently from App Store icons. Keep a backup before experimenting with system app customizations.
